name: Office service connection deadline and bound
summary: Every connection the office web service accepts has a deadline covering its whole wait and the number of connections is bounded. A connection over the bound is closed at once, a connection that says nothing is closed after 30 seconds rather than held, and a thread that cannot serve its connection gives the place up once. A thread that is only starting is never taken for a dead one: the reaper counts a thread dead only once its start has returned (kittrial-5bb.175).
